verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a user-configurable rule or trigger engine that runs actions automatically when events occur. Merged work moving to Done is a fixed built-in behavior, not a rule the user defines. Reusable workflows are not described as event-triggered, and branch rules and GitHub Actions belong to GitHub, the host platform, not to LightSprint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
